palettePolicy.rule: Only the ten canonical hex colors in colorMeta may be used as solid UI colors. Alpha and color-mix variants are allowed; extra shade hexes and Tailwind chromatic utilities are forbidden.
palettePolicy.compositionAuthority: Stitch code.html and screen.png win over default component composition; the normalized palette wins over Stitch colors.
palettePolicy.icons: Lucide is the default. Add at most one external icon library, only when Lucide has no suitable icon.

identity.rule: Keep the complete object-contained FPT asset and orange LearnAble wordmark on one row. The visible FPT mark is larger and never cropped; dynamic user.role sits beneath LearnAble.

narrative.overview: Corporate modern high-legibility for an inclusive university environment. Every route uses one normalized palette. Stitch composition remains authoritative for Lecturer surfaces while the unified palette remains authoritative for color.
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces and readable navy/slate hierarchy.
One orange, one blue, one green, one red and one yellow semantic vocabulary.
Complete institutional identity and responsive workbenches.
Explicit loading, error, unavailable and local-only states.

rules.name: The Ten-Color Rule
rules.body: Solid UI colors are limited to the ten approved hexes. Alpha and color-mix variants are allowed; extra shade hexes and Tailwind chromatic utilities are forbidden.

dos: Do preserve Stitch composition while applying the normalized palette.
Do keep the complete FPT logo visually larger than orange LearnAble, with the dynamic role below.
Do use Lucide by default and preserve visible focus and non-color status cues.
donts: Don't introduce extra shade hexes or Tailwind chromatic utilities.
Don't crop the FPT logo or let LearnAble dominate it.
Don't report backend success for disconnected writes or local-only state.
